newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on long liquidation, CBOT soy.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on long liquidation, CBOT soy.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on March long liquidation and lower CBOT soycomplex values, traders said.

"There was massive long liquidation of the March, Cargill and the Pools were selling, Chicago was lower, crushers bought March, May and July scale down and the Japanese covered shorts," a trader said. March canola futures crush margin fell to -22.36 Wednesday from -20.91 Tuesday. March-May spread at even money.
Japan bought 10,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
March canola fell $3.30 to $413.40, May down $3.30 to $413.10. March flax lost $1.90 to $350.10 on commercials.

March western barley ended unchanged at $139.90 with Alberta Wheat Pool selling, RBC-DS short covering, May rose $1 to $139.50 with Midland Walwyn the best buyer, a trader said. July-Oct spread at $2. Volume was 2,000 lots.
March feed wheat ended unchanged at $171.70 on commission houses, May rose $0.60 to $167.50. Oct-Dec spread at even money, May-Dec $8.80. Volume was 950 lots.
The Pools bid for feed peas but none traded, sources noted. Also, there was no trade in oats.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
